written.headline: MIT researchers show LLMs can read and edit neural network weights without retraining
written.summary: MIT’s CSAIL team demonstrated that a large language model (GPT‑6 Astra) can examine and modify a neural network’s weights directly, improving a small language model by changing only 0.016% of its parameters. In experiments the model raised the MATH‑500 score from 7.9% to 48.1% and GSM8K from 13.8% to 67.1%.

written.headline: Anthropic reports Q3 revenue near $17 billion as compute commitments rise to $895 billion
written.summary: Anthropic's amended IPO filing shows third‑quarter revenue of about $17 billion, a 46% increase from the prior quarter, while compute and infrastructure commitments total roughly $895 billion, including $70 billion due by September 2027.

written.headline: Huawei says Ascend 960DT AI chip will use Samsung and SK Hynix HBM
written.summary: Huawei told some customers that a large share of its upcoming flagship AI chip, Ascend 960DT, will be equipped with high‑bandwidth memory from Samsung and SK Hynix, which is being smuggled into China via board‑packaging loopholes.

written.headline: PowerUp Money raises $10 million to expand AI‑led wealth management in India
written.summary: PowerUp Money secured $10 million in a round led by Flourish Ventures and will use the funds to develop its AI‑powered wealth advisory platform and expand its managed advisory service Infinite. The Bengaluru startup, with over 1.5 million users and 1 lakh paid Elite members, says Infinite has amassed nearly Rs 500 crore AUM.
